sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A description of the "rats" that have snuck into Ashina. Speak to the Tengu again once the rats are dealt with.
The rats:
- Assassins from Senpou Temple.
- Short stature, wear bamboo hats.
- A number of rats are lurking about.
- Last seen around Ashina Castle Gate.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The Rat required to fulfill the Tengu's request is located hiding behind a tree after the Ashina Castle Gate Sculptor's Idol to the right, nearby two other Rats that can be eavesdropped upon.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - If Wolf declines the Tengu's request, after defeating Genichiro and coming to know Isshin's whereabouts from Kuro, this item will be found in the original spot of the Tengu.
